Messages.Author: alasteir
Messages.Body:
Hi everyone, there's a lot of time since my last topic.

A doubt:

If the lasombra Nahir goes to torpor with a research counter on her do you still remain with the enlarged handsize?

I assume yes, because the she has two habilities, divised by a períod, first the one to get THE counters, wich specifies that she needs to be ready, and the other, wich doesn't say this.

What you say?

Nahir
Clan: Lasombra (group 3)
Capacity: 10
Disciplines: ANI DOM OBT POT tha
Sabbat: If Nahir is ready, you may use a master phase action to burn 1
pool to put a research counter on her. Your hand size is +X, where X
is the number of research counters she has. +1 bleed.

Vitor Hugo

Sabbat. Vitor gets +1 vote against any referendum of a political action.

Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:
> Hakuron wrote:
> Given you have enough master phase actions, can you use Nahir's special more than once per turn?
>
Yes.

Similarly, you can use Ayo Igoli's special more than once per turn, if you have multiple discard phase actions.
[LSJ 20080501]
>
> LSJ wrote:
> > So I have Cagliostro, Powerbase: Los Angeles, Port Authority,
> > Camirilla Threats and Ayo Igoli play.
> >
> > If I use all three discard phase action to discard cards, I will take
> > 3 pool damage and have my hand size reduced by 3. correct?
>
> You will have paid three pool in order to do so, yes.
>
> And you will have three cards you are not replacing which count against your
> hand size, yes.
>
> > May Ayo put 2 blood on a younger uncontrolled laibon 3 times? I think
> > not.
>
> Yes, if you do that instead of using the discard phase actions to discard cards.
>
> Or you can mix it up:
>
> Pay a pool to use one dpa to discard a card (which you don't replace until your
> untap phase), and use one to move two blood from Ayo to an uncontrolled Laibon
> and use the last one to move two blood from Ayo to another uncontroller Laibon.
>
Ayo Igoli:
You may use a discard phase action to move 2 blood from Ayo to a Laibon in your uncontrolled region.

Messages.Author: Tendoncutter
Messages.Body:
So, this would also apply to Khalids ability, then?

"Camarilla primogen: During your master phase, if Khalid is ready, you may use a master phase action and discard a card that requires Obfuscate from your hand to gain a pool."

Good way to cycle stealth if you're getting jammed

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Tendoncutter wrote:
> So, this would also apply to Khalids ability, then?
>
> "Camarilla primogen: During your master phase, if Khalid is ready, you may use a master phase action and discard a card that requires Obfuscate from your hand to gain a pool."
>
No.
See rulebook:

“During X, do Y”: The “during X do Y” template is used in several cards. When this template is used, only one Y can be done per X with this card. For instance, you may move blood from your vampire to your pool with Vessel only once per unlock phase.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
